title: Focus After 8 Hours of Screens a Day: What Really Changes at Work
content: An eight-hour screen day is no longer unusual. For many knowledge workers, it is simply the job: email, team chat, CRM dashboards, spreadsheets, video calls, research and presentations – followed, often, by more screen time after work. But eight hours is not a magic neurological threshold where concentration suddenly collapses. The more useful question is […]
